evidence: The film properties were analyzed using field-emission scanning electron microscopy, atomic force microscopy, Rutherford backscattering spectroscopy, and elastic recoil detection-time of flight. The film thickness was measured using a Tencor a-step profilometer, and very thin films were also measured by transmission electron microscopy (TEM). The step coverage with a patterned substrate was analyzed using field-emission scanning electron microscopy (FESEM). The surface roughness was analyzed using atomic force microscopy (AFM) and the elemental composition of the film was measured via Rutherford backscattering spectroscopy (RBS) and elastic recoil detection-time of flight (ERD-TOF).
